The Hybrid Ray Tracer casts rays through both data types and composites them.
**Volumetric Sampling**: Compute a vector of colors $c_v$ and opacities $o_v$ by resampling the volumetric data at equally spaced positions along the ray.

*   If range($C_q$) > $\theta$ and range($C_x$) $\le \theta$: Geometric event is hidden by opaque volumetric data.
*   If range($C_x$) > $\theta$ and range($C_q$) > $\theta$: Region contains a visible geometric event.
